comments.text: BTW, egypts population is 120m, not 109m, and there are over 10 million refugees living in egypt, making the people living in egypt over 130m

replies.author: @FortuneOfNations
replies.text: Refugees make the real number much harder to pin down: the UN's migration agency estimated around 9 million migrants and refugees in Egypt in 2022. Whatever the exact total, the squeeze only grows: the UN expects about 160 million people by 2050, on the same thin strip of river.

comments.author: @Chron-c3i
comments.text: Bro how do you make this type of animation

replies.author: @FortuneOfNations
replies.text: Everything moves in code, with no video generator involved. Each scene is basically a web page: real satellite and elevation maps underneath, and a script that moves the camera and drops in every label and number on the exact word it's spoken. Then it's rendered out frame by frame.

replies.author: @FortuneOfNations
replies.text: The number depends on who's counting. We used Egypt's statistics agency, CAPMAS, which put the population inside the country at about 109 million in May 2026. Some international estimates run higher, and millions of Egyptians also live abroad.
